evidence.note: Title claims 'Most staff would cycle if the site had showers'; it rests on the 58% stat below.
Stat '58%' of staff who drive said showers would make them cycle twice a week; no citation on the slide itself.
Note defines the sample (staff driving to site 3+ days a week) and names the source: 'regional commuter survey, 2025'.

rationale: The slide makes one factual claim, the 58% figure (restated as the title), and the reader note attaches a named, dated source and the survey population to it. Nothing else on the slide is a factual claim, number or date. That matches the pass descriptor: claim and source together via the note.
